entries.en: I'll get right to the point, . The higher-ups have authorized plans to form a specialized squad and we're on the lookout for a reliable leader. Your name was at the top of the list.

The higher-ups have authorized plans to form a specialized squad and we're on the lookout for a reliable leader. Your name was at the top of the list.
entries.fr: Laissez-moi vous expliquer. Notre grande compagnie tente depuis peu de constituer des escouades d'aventuriers dans le but d'élargir notre champ d'action. Seulement pour ça, il nous faut des chefs capables de les diriger. Vous voyez où je veux en venir ?
entries.ja:
現在、新設予定の「冒険者小隊」の隊長候補に、
お主の名前が挙がっていてな……。

entries.en: You would be responsible for training and commanding a number of adventurer subordinates, and the position also comes with the possibility of further promotion. What say you, ? Are you ready to lead?

entries.en: Ah. Well, that's not the response I was hoping for, but it's best we're all honest here. A hesitant commander is a danger to  own troops.

entries.fr: Je comprends... La vie d'hommes et de femmes est un bien lourd fardeau à endosser. Si vous ne vous sentez pas capable d'assumer une telle pression, mieux vaut confier cette mission à quelqu'un d'autre.
entries.ja:
そうか……残念だが、仕方あるまい。
覚悟のない者に、兵たちの命を預けるわけにはいかないからな。
